subject: gov.policy
name: Conselho Consultivo da Economia Digital
milestone: Third ordinary meeting held 2025-11-25
position_start: Standing consultative body chaired by the minister responsible for the digital economy; the repository records no meeting before 2025-11-25
position_end: At that meeting the state set its digital programme on three pillars, digital public services, e-commerce and digital payments, supported by four declared work areas; no meeting after 2025-11-25 is recorded

subject: gov.policy
name: Data Strategy for Public Administration
milestone: Kick-off meeting held 2026-04-28
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Development process launched with senior officials, the Secretary of State for the Digital Economy, external consultants and European Union representatives; the stated goal is to move government from siloed systems to integrated collection and use of data across departments. No draft, adoption date or lead institution is published
note: The 2026-04-28 date is attributed in the source to a wire agency, not to the reporting outlet

subject: gov.policy
name: Estrategia da Economia Digital de Cabo Verde
milestone: Approved by Resolucao 88/2024, gazetted 4 October 2024
position_start: In existence and in implementation; a named analyst argued on 2025-04-07 for accelerating it
position_end: In force by resolution for 2024-2030, setting the vision of a Nacao Digital, six strategic pillars and 37 strategic objectives, with coordination, implementation, monitoring, evaluation and revision vested in the digital economy ministry through its telecommunications and digital economy directorate. The full pillar-by-pillar text carries measure MI 9, implementation of an artificial intelligence strategy, as still to be taken

subject: gov.policy
name: Estrategia Nacional para o 5G
milestone: Approved by Resolucao 33/2026 of 2026-02-20
position_start: Did not exist; presented as a proposal at TechPark Cabo Verde on 2025-09-10 under the World-Bank-financed Digital Cabo Verde project
position_end: In force by resolution, targeting 90% internet penetration by 2026 and regional digital-hub status by 2030, with the economic impact put by government at more than CVE 77 billion by 2036; no spectrum assignment, licence award or network build is on file
note: The 90%-by-2026 penetration target cannot be tested; the repository holds no ARME quarter later than Q2 2025

subject: gov.policy
name: Estrategia para a Governacao Digital de Cabo Verde 2021-2024
milestone: Retificacao 190/2021 republishes the strategy in full
position_end: The gazetted full text stands as the country's only published statement of a government cloud commitment: its annex of fifty-five estruturantes lists EST-TEC7 Cloud de Governo as already existing, consumed by three measures, under the intervention area Infraestrutura e seguranca. The same annex records EST-TEC2 Plataforma de Integracao e Interoperabilidade as not existing in 2021. No separate cloud or data-storage strategy instrument is held

subject: gov.policy
name: Mandate to define the national interoperability framework
milestone: Resolucao 46/2025 vests the mandate in the Equipa de Servico Digital
position_end: The mandate exists and the framework does not. Resolucao 46/2025 creates the Portal Unico, names Identificacao, Interoperabilidade and Pagamentos as the digital public infrastructure building blocks, vests in the Equipa de Servico Digital the competences to coordinate implementation of the interoperability layer and to define the interoperability framework and make it mandatory for all electronic governance initiatives, and requires NOSi to ensure every public administration information system carries APIs allowing articulation with the portal. No framework document has been published since

subject: gov.policy
name: National 5G implementation strategy
milestone: Gazetted as Resolution 33/2026, 20 February 2026
position_start: No fifth-generation strategy (2025-08)
position_end: An eight-article resolution approves the national strategy for implementing fifth-generation technology, setting its objectives, components, coordination and governance between the digital economy directorate and the regulator (2026-02)

subject: gov.policy
name: National digital transformation agenda
milestone: Resolucao 72/2026 approved the agenda's strategic bases; strategic consultation convened 2026-08-06
position_start: Did not exist; the PAEGDCV action plan was the plan of record and ran to 2025-12-31
position_end: The Council of Ministers approved Resolucao 72/2026 setting the strategic bases of the Agenda Digital de Cabo Verde 2035 in eight axes, and a strategic consultation on the digital future was convened in August 2026 to feed the national diagnosis and the agenda's priorities; no adopted agenda text, adoption date or budget is held
note: A national newspaper report of the act; no text of Resolucao 72/2026 was reachable on the Boletim Oficial

subject: gov.policy
name: National Governance Framework for Digital Transformation
milestone: Terms of reference issued by the Ministry of Finance under Digital Cabo Verde additional financing
position_start: Terms of reference issued for a framework to be coordinated by the Prime Minister's Office through a Government Digital Service Team; no framework published
position_end: Unchanged; the repository holds no framework document and no record that the Government Digital Service Team was established
sources: 2025-01-01 Cabo Verde MoF - ToR National Governance Framework for Digital Transformation
note: The source date is year precision and proxy, so it fixes the year of issue, not an event date

subject: gov.policy
name: PAEGDCV digital governance action plan 2021-2025
milestone: Plan horizon ended 2025-12-31; no successor gazetted
position_start: The plan of record for digital governance, presented to the CPLP interministerial meeting on 2025-03-25, with interoperability between systems and electronic authentication as its stated components
position_end: Horizon ended. The repository holds no successor plan, no extension and no evaluation, so the 2026 digital-nation statements run without a current published action plan
note: The absence of a successor is the finding, not a gap tracked elsewhere

subject: gov.policy
name: Plataforma Eletronica de Contratacao Publica
milestone: Mandatory for 2026 under Decreto-Lei 1/2026, art. 2
position_start: Electronic public procurement operating since 2020 for central government, with a 2025 redefinition of requirements under way
position_end: Re-let at CVE 70,000,000 over four years, the government's own conversion EUR 634,834, on terms of perpetual licensing, unlimited users, deployment on national infrastructure and full control of source code; extended to local administration and to autonomous services and funds, and mandatory for 2026
note: The award, signature and commencement dates are not stated; 2008-2015 in-house attempts were discontinued

subject: gov.policy
name: Priorities for the United Nations partnership cycle
milestone: Priorities named at a high-level meeting, Praia, 2026-09-10
position_start: Not previously held by this repository
position_end: The prime minister named state modernisation and digital transformation, alongside climate action, decentralisation and youth opportunity, as the government's priorities for the new phase of its partnership with the United Nations, at a high-level meeting with the country team in Praia on 10 September 2026.
note: priorities stated at a meeting: no cooperation framework document, envelope, timetable or named programme is published, so what the digital priority commits either side to is not established

subject: gov.policy
name: Rule that state data exchange runs through PDEX
milestone: Restated in the health ministry's own procurement terms
position_end: The Ministry of Health's terms of reference state that PDEX is the State's principal integration and interoperability platform and that all data interoperability between state institutions must go through it, that any API handling personal data requires authorisation from the data-protection commission, and that Autentika is the platform an application must register with as a service provider. It is a routing rule for state data rather than a localisation rule: no instrument requires public data to be stored in the country

subject: gov.policy
name: Semana do Digital
milestone: Instituted by Resolucao 24/2026, published in the Boletim Oficial
position_start: Held as an event with no standing instrument; the repository carries no legal basis for it at 2025-08-01
position_end: Instituted as an annual national platform with five stated objectives covering digital literacy, public-sector modernisation, digitalisation of the economy, startup support and monitoring of the digital strategy; the 2026 edition ran 9-15 March in hybrid format, opening on Brava
note: Financed from the state budget and partnerships; no budget line for the week is identified in any budget document held

subject: gov.policy
name: Target of 60% of vital public services online by 2026
milestone: Target restated at a World Bank support mission
position_start: Target of at least 60% of vital public services online by 2026 and 80% by 2030, stated by NOSi and carried in World Bank project documentation; no measured delivery figure held
position_end: Unchanged and restated; the repository holds no count or percentage of services actually online at any date, so delivery cannot be tested
sources: 2024-01-01 Cabo Verde targets 60pct of vital public services online by 2026 (NOSi)|2025-09-29-world-bank-digital-transformation-support-techafricanews|2025-05-02-digital-cabo-verde-additional-financing-project-paper
note: The target year ends inside 2026, so it cannot yet be recorded as passed

subject: gov.legislate
name: Artificial-intelligence statute

subject: gov.legislate
name: Cybercrime statute and national cybersecurity framework instrument

subject: gov.legislate
name: Decreto-Legislativo 7/2018 and 8/2018, the payment system and payment services regimes
milestone: Both diplomas gazetted in one bulletin
position_end: Decreto-Legislativo 7/2018 enacts the Sistema de Pagamentos Cabo-Verdiano and confers on the Banco de Cabo Verde its governance role: policy-setting for payment-system modernisation, superintendencia over the safety and efficiency of payment systems and instruments, power to issue general rules, to inspect participants and operators, to designate systems and operators, and to provide infrastructure and settlement. Decreto-Legislativo 8/2018, in the same bulletin, is the codified regime for the provision of payment services and the issue, distribution and reimbursement of electronic money

subject: gov.legislate
name: Decreto-Lei 13/2014, constituting NOSi as a public business entity
milestone: Gazetted 2014-02-25
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: In force as the instrument constituting the Nucleo Operacional da Sociedade de Informacao, E.P.E.

subject: gov.legislate
name: Decreto-Lei 19/2014, creating the Cartao Nacional de Identificacao
milestone: Gazetted 17 March 2014
position_end: In force as the instrument creating the identity card and governing its issue, replacement, use and cancellation. The card is optional from birth and compulsory from age four, its Numero de Identificacao Civil is generated through the SNIAC connection, and the data printed and encoded on it, filiation included, is drawn from the birth registration act

subject: gov.legislate
name: Diploma on interoperability standards for public-administration systems
milestone: Named as a 2024 legislative deliverable to the National Assembly's First Committee
position_start: Announced for drafting in 2024 under the state-modernisation strategy; no adoption on record
position_end: Unchanged; no evidence the diploma was adopted, two years past its stated year, while interoperability is asserted as a working property of the government portal and the company registry
note: The gap between an asserted interoperability layer and an unadopted standards instrument is the finding

subject: gov.legislate
name: Diploma regulating data governance in the public administration
milestone: Named as a 2024 legislative deliverable to the National Assembly's First Committee
position_start: Announced for drafting in 2024; no adoption on record
position_end: Unchanged; no evidence of adoption at 2026-08-06. A companion diploma on documentary classification, announced in the same statement, is likewise unadopted
note: A distinct instrument from the data-protection law the data-protection commission enforces

subject: gov.legislate
name: General authorisation regime for electronic communications
milestone: Five authorised operators reported in ARME's Q2 2025 indicators
position_start: Five operators authorised after ARME granted two new general authorisations in 2024; Starlink began activity in January 2025
position_end: Unchanged; no further authorisation or licensing change is recorded
note: No ARME budget or activity report is held for any year, so the regulator's own account of its licensing work is unavailable

subject: gov.legislate
name: Legal frameworks for digital services, e-commerce and digital banking
milestone: Declared as a component of the 5G strategy presented 2025-09-10
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Named among the declared reach of the National 5G Strategy approved on 2026-02-20, alongside a regulatory and business framework to support investment; no bill, draft or diploma is held
note: A stated legislative programme covering three fields, not a single named instrument

subject: gov.legislate
name: Satellite communications regulatory framework (ARME)
milestone: Public consultation opened by ARME on licensing, spectrum and network-security rules for satellite operators, submissions to 31 August 2026
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Consultation covers licensing, radio-spectrum use, frequency coordination, user protection, network security and emergency communications for satellite operators; a direct regulatory response to Starlink's December 2024 launch in the archipelago; no draft text or adoption date is published
note: distinct from the existing general-authorisation regime under which Starlink was licensed in 2024

subject: gov.protect
name: Accession to Council of Europe Convention 108

subject: gov.protect
name: Accession to the AU Malabo Convention
status: Enacted, accession approved by the National Assembly
milestone: Resolucao 153/IX/2020 gazetted 2020-03-17
position_start: No signature, ratification or entry-into-force date held
position_end: The National Assembly approved accession to the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection by Resolucao 153/IX/2020, gazetted with the Convention's full Portuguese text
note: Accession to Council of Europe Convention 108 remains unestablished and is carried as its own row

subject: gov.protect
name: Comissao Nacional de Proteccao de Dados
milestone: Tenth-anniversary international conference on data protection and artificial intelligence
position_start: Independent supervisory authority operating from 2015-16, with fining powers and referral of possible criminal matters to the public prosecution; a member of the Global Privacy Assembly
position_end: Powers unchanged. The president stated the authority was entering a phase more attentive to digital innovation, and named retention of technical staff as a standing constraint, every technician who started in 2016 having left
note: On the face of its own site the authority has published no genuine activity report since 2016: every 2017-2023 link points at that year's plan rather than a report

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection commission activity report and any enforcement measure

subject: gov.protect
name: Data-protection commission appropriation
milestone: Appropriated CVE 36,313,115 for FY2025 by Resolucao 160/X/2024
position_start: CVE 36,313,115 for FY2025, appropriated inside the National Assembly's own private budget rather than through any ministerial vote, a 3.0% uplift on CVE 35,255,451 for FY2024, with zero own-source revenue in both years
position_end: FY2025 remains the latest established appropriation. Against the fining powers the statute confers, an annual budget of about CVE 36 million is roughly a dozen maximum penalties
note: The FY2026 budget volume contains no occurrence of the commission in 266 pages, so its FY2026 appropriation is unestablished

subject: gov.protect
name: Delegation of powers over the intelligence service
milestone: Despacho no 15/2026 published in the official gazette
position_start: Not previously held by this repository
position_end: The prime minister's delegation of powers over the Republic's information service to the minister of internal administration was formalised by despacho no 15/2026 in the official gazette, and has generated legal and political controversy, reported 8 September 2026. The opposition calls the act unconstitutional; the government invokes the delegation regime provided for in the Organic Law of the Government; the President of the Republic has discussed it with the prime minister but is declining to address it publicly.
note: the despacho text is not held; what the delegated powers cover, whether they touch communications interception or data access, and whether any court has been seised are not established from the account

subject: gov.protect
name: Judicial police access to the national video-surveillance system
milestone: Claim restated by the national director at the force's 33rd anniversary; no access granted
position_start: A formal request was made to the Interior Minister in mid-2024; the force had no effective access
position_end: Still no effective access. The Justice Minister called the claim justified and said steps were under way with the Interior Ministry, which manages the system, alongside expansion projects in several cities and islands
note: No legal basis, safeguard or data-protection opinion on inter-institutional image sharing is held

subject: gov.protect
name: Lei 133/V/2001, general data-protection regime
milestone: Position stated by the data-protection commission president; last amended 2021
position_start: General regime closely mirroring the EU standard, with administrative fines of CVE 50,000-3,000,000, cessation, blocking and deletion measures, and criminal penalties up to two years; amended in 2013, creating the commission, and in 2021, requiring designation of data-protection officers
position_end: Unchanged; no amendment is recorded in the window. A named analyst argued on 2025-04-07 for aligning it with artificial intelligence and adding mechanisms for algorithmic supervision; no bill is held
sources: 2024-01-01 Cabo Verde data protection - Digital Regulations in the Metaverse Era (IBA)|2025-02-02-cnpd-faustino-varela-ia-big-data-direitos-expressodasilhas|2025-04-07-revolucao-tecnologica-opiniao-expressodasilhas
note: The commission president said on 2025-02-02 that several institutions had not complied with the data-protection officer obligation

subject: gov.regional
name: African Digital Corridor with Nigeria
milestone: Support agreement signed in Abuja during the Secretary of State's mission
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Launched in early September 2025 with cooperation priorities of artificial intelligence, youth empowerment and bilateral development. Declared deliverables are training of over 500 secondary students on three islands, STEM tools in Portuguese and teacher training, and a business and innovation mission in Praia in Q4 2025; the repository holds no record that either was delivered
note: Promoted by a private organisation, not by a treaty instrument

subject: gov.regional
name: Any act of ratification or transposition of a regional or continental digital instrument
milestone: Resolucao 153/IX/2020 gazetted 2020-03-17
position_start: No act of ratification or transposition held
position_end: Resolucao 153/IX/2020 approves accession to the AU Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection; no ECOWAS supplementary act is held as transposed

subject: gov.regional
name: CPLP digital rights charter
milestone: Signed at São Tomé by all nine member states, 19 July 2024
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Expressly declaratory and non-binding, committing members to meaningful connectivity on non-discriminatory and affordable terms, personal data protection, cybersecurity cooperation, digital literacy and capacity building and non-fragmentation of the digital environment, and condemning blanket internet shutdowns
note: declaratory: no domestic measure is recorded as taken under it

subject: gov.regional
name: Legal regime for transfer of personal data abroad
milestone: Lei 41/VIII/2013 amends the general data-protection regime
position_end: Article 19 makes transfer of personal data abroad conditional on the destination assuring an adequate level of protection and vests in the data-protection commission the decision whether a foreign State does so; article 20 sets the derogations under which the commission may permit transfer to a country without adequacy, and allows authorisation where the controller offers sufficient guarantees, expressly including adequate contractual clauses. No adequacy decision by the commission is held

subject: gov.regional
name: Memorandum of cooperation between the data-protection commissions of Cabo Verde and Macau
milestone: Signed in Macau 1 June 2026
position_end: A five-year renewable memorandum committing both authorities to joint training and seminars, support for investigations involving both territories, joint studies and exchange of legal interpretations and publications. It creates a supervisory channel over data moving between the two jurisdictions and no authorisation or technical transfer mechanism

subject: gov.standards
name: Catalogue of Cabo Verdean national standards
milestone: Catalogue updated March 2024
position_end: The national standards body publishes the whole Cabo Verdean corpus as 25 standards, NCV 001:2015 to NCV 025:2023: twenty-one agricultural, fisheries and food product standards issued 2015-2016 and four tourism standards issued 2020-2023. It carries no information and communications technology, data or information-management standard of any kind

subject: gov.standards
name: Independent evaluation of the Instituto Nacional de Estatistica
milestone: Announced by the Prime Minister in the State of the Nation debate
position_start: Did not exist; the integrity dispute stood as anonymous technicians' allegations of 2025-08-10 against the institute's rejection of 2025-09-17
position_end: An evaluation ordered by the head of government to establish alleged interference and manipulation of data, which the institute's board said on 2026-08-03 it would host, offering all technical documentation; nothing is established about its terms of reference, who conducts it, when it reports, or whether findings will be published
note: Both the allegation and the rebuttal are recorded and neither is adopted

subject: gov.standards
name: Interoperability obligation in place of a standards catalogue
milestone: Decreto-Lei 47/2022 gazetted
position_end: No separately promulgated technical interoperability standards document exists. Decreto-Lei 47/2022 stands in its place: it regulates the duty to inform, makes prior opinion mandatory for acquisition of information and communications technology goods and services across the central public administration, and approves the coordination procedure for digital transformation initiatives, requiring alignment with the State's transversal solutions including the authentication platform and the data-exchange platform, with the state modernisation directorate reviewing significant investments in articulation with the state technology operator

subject: gov.standards
name: Membership status in the African Telecommunications Union

subject: gov.discourse
name: Open Government Partnership National Multisector Forum
milestone: Seventh Forum meeting held 2026-02-26 to prepare the third action plan
position_start: No named forum or consultation mechanism held
position_end: The Forum met for the seventh time in February 2026 to reformulate its membership and prepare the third National Action Plan for Open Government, the second having been completed in 2025; the eParticipa platform is separately in service as a citizen-administration channel

subject: finance.budget
name: Cabo Verde Plataforma Digital e da Inovacao programme
milestone: Q1 2026 provisional account, positions at 2026-03-31
position_start: Voted CVE 851,504,207 for FY2025 across treasury, loans and grants, down from CVE 1,828,303,885 in FY2024
position_end: Voted CVE 513,994,724 for FY2026 with no external borrowing at all; by 2026-03-31 CVE 1,445,586,717 of loans had been reprogrammed into the programme, nearly three times its whole voted total, against 14.7% execution
note: In FY2025 the programme drew 99.3% of its voted treasury share; what went undrawn was the borrowed money, not the voted money

subject: finance.budget
name: Ciber Seguranca budget unit
milestone: Inscribed as a new budget unit in Lei 69/X/2025
position_start: None published; the FY2024 and FY2025 budget volumes carry no cybersecurity rubric at any published grain, five years after the 2021 decree created the national CSIRT, with the money sitting inside NOSi's trading account
position_end: CVE 20,000,000 appropriated as a newly inscribed budget unit under general public services - the first cybersecurity line in the Cabo Verdean budget, at 0.02% of state expenditure, stated in the law's narrative with no table breaking it out
note: The Q1 2026 provisional account reports by programme and does not break out budget units, so no execution figure exists

subject: finance.budget
name: Civil-identification earmark
milestone: Appropriated unchanged in Lei 69/X/2025
position_start: CVE 306,516,802 for FY2025 against the identity-document issue-and-replacement fee, split across electronic passport, identity card, residence permit and running costs
position_end: The same CVE 306,516,802 for FY2026 to the escudo; the only change across three budgets is a label, one sub-line moving to the justice-modernisation institute
note: A fee-financed ceiling rolled forward rather than re-estimated, though the FY2026 law's narrative presents these lines as new project entries

subject: finance.budget
name: Data-protection commission appropriation for FY2026

subject: finance.budget
name: Ministerio da Economia Digital appropriation
milestone: Reprogrammed position recorded at 2026-03-31
position_start: CVE 369,781,930 appropriated for FY2025, down 73.4% on FY2024's CVE 1,390,965,632, with capital appropriated at a printed zero
position_end: CVE 174,200,533 appropriated for FY2026, an 87.5% fall across two budgets while total state expenditure rose 11.3%, leaving the digital vote at 0.18% of state spending against 1.62% in FY2024, with capital at a printed zero for a second year; the reprogrammed budget stood at CVE 1,614,624,282 at 2026-03-31, 9.3 times the voted figure
note: Execution against the reprogrammed budget was 33.0% in FY2024, 37.9% in FY2025 and 10.1% at Q1 2026 against 18.6% state-wide

subject: finance.budget
name: Modernizacao do Estado e da Administracao Publica programme
milestone: Q1 2026 provisional account, positions at 2026-03-31
position_start: Voted CVE 5,434,369,323 on the programme axis for FY2025, against CVE 609,582,068 in FY2024, the perimeter having grown roughly ninefold so most of the FY2025 figure is not digital
position_end: Voted CVE 976,042,125 for FY2026, an 82% fall on FY2025; the programme executed 96.0% of its reprogrammed budget in FY2025 and 11.5% at Q1 2026, and its FY2024 investment line executed 0.4%
note: The perimeter is unstable across the three years, so the series is not a like-for-like trend

subject: finance.budget
name: NOSi forecast service revenue and state protocols
milestone: Forecast in the Plano de Atividades e Orcamento 2026
position_start: CVE 1,486,249,000 forecast for 2025, four times the digital ministry's vote; FY2024 outturn CVE 1,000,587,000, with protocolled services billed to the state at CVE 455,964,000 against CVE 333,345,000 budgeted
position_end: CVE 1,094,297,000 forecast for 2026, down 26%, against a CVE 174,200,533 vote - a ratio of 6.3 times; the protocols line is frozen at CVE 333,345,000 for a third consecutive year under a service protocol signed in December 2021
note: No NOSi accounts have been published since the FY2024 volume, so the FY2025 and FY2026 forecasts are untested

subject: finance.budget
name: Orcamento Retificativo do Estado para 2026
milestone: Approved by the Assembleia Nacional 2026-07-31
position_start: Did not exist. Cabo Verde passed no rectificative budget for 2025, so its revised position that year was administrative rather than statutory - twelve monthly virement files carrying 45,590 rows and a state-wide reprogrammed budget 11.5% above the appropriation with no statute behind it
position_end: Approved at CVE 103,888 million against the CVE 95,675 million voted for 2026 and a projected execution of CVE 104,011 million; connectivity is named among the priorities of the reorganisation and no digital figure is given. The act was not in the Boletim Oficial at 2026-08-04
note: Its organic table will be the first statutory revised table of the period and is what settles whether the digital ministry's reprogrammed budget is ratified or reversed

subject: finance.budget
name: Sistema de Informacao para o Desenvolvimento Sustentavel programme
milestone: Q1 2026 provisional account, positions at 2026-03-31
position_start: Voted CVE 391,535,782 for FY2025 across treasury and loans, down from CVE 788,167,895 in FY2024
position_end: Voted CVE 290,706,686 for FY2026, entirely from the treasury with no borrowing; execution against the reprogrammed budget ran 9.8% in FY2024, 77.2% in FY2025 and 26.5% at Q1 2026
note: The state spent almost all of its own money on its statistical system in FY2024 and almost none of what it had borrowed for it

subject: finance.mou
name: NOSi memorandum of understanding with Angola's public finance IT body
milestone: Signed in Praia 2026-03-03
position_start: Did not exist; the two bodies had been in contact since 2023 with no instrument on the record
position_end: Memorandum signed in Praia by NOSi's executive administrator and the Angolan body's director-general in the presence of Angola's ambassador, covering cybersecurity, data-centre management, audit and internal control, and customer service
note: No value, duration or workplan is stated

subject: finance.mou
name: Protocol on Membership with the Tech Diplomacy Global Institute
milestone: Protocol signed in Praia, reported 2026-03-18
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Protocol signed and a Tech Ambassador designated, described by the institute as the second such appointment in Africa; no fee, obligation or term is stated
note: The signature date is not stated in the source; the position is dated to the report, which carries a wire-release provenance flag

subject: finance.new
name: Balcao unico for startups
milestone: Announced at the Alumni Talk 2026 opening
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: Announced as a one-stop shop staffed by newly hired legal, administrative and financing specialists whose function is to route founders to finance instruments that already exist; nothing held gives it a legal instrument, a location, a staff complement, a budget or an opening date
note: Announced alongside a stated availability of about EUR 100 million for digital investment in coming years, which is not an appropriation

subject: finance.new
name: Cabo Verde Regional Digital Connectivity framework loan
position_start: EUR 37,000,000 European Investment Bank framework loan signed within a EUR 80 million total cost, under the EU Global Gateway, financing a branch from a new Europe-South Africa submarine cable, modernisation of the national transmission network and an upgrade of the incumbent's information systems
position_end: Unchanged; disbursement is recorded as zero on the financier's record as accessed 2026-06-24, and no drawdown, works-start or completion record is held
note: Whether this is the same money as the April 2026 state guarantee to the incumbent is not established, and summing them would double-count

subject: finance.new
name: Digital Cabo Verde Project
milestone: Recorded closing date of 2025-10-31 passed with the project still financing activity
position_start: Active; US$20,000,000 committed on 2020-11-12 with an additional credit of about US$20 million proposed in May 2025, and targets of 60% of public services online by 2026 and 80% by 2030
position_end: Still financing activity after its recorded closing date - a World Bank support mission in September 2025, the digital-skills programme from January 2026 and the public-sector hackathon in May 2026 - while NOSi's donor-financed revenue line fell 52% to CVE 111,581,000 for 2026
note: The held record carries a closing date of 2025-10-31 and an end year of 2028 in the same table; neither is reconciled and no closure or extension notice is held

subject: finance.new
name: E-Governance and Public Financial Management Reform Programme, Phase II
milestone: Financing agreement signed 2025-12-31

position_end: The standing national instrument for economic and financial operations with the exterior and for exchange operations in national territory. name: Sistema de Informacao da Justica, criminal-process component
milestone: Formally handed over by NOSi to the Ministry of Justice
position_start: In use by lawyers to reach and track cases without travelling to the comarcas, with design work running with the superior judicial councils since 2021
position_end: Criminal-process system completed and in operation in every comarca in the country, with maintenance passed from NOSi to the justice-modernisation institute; the civil-process component was to begin implementation in April 2026
note: No cost, contract or vendor figure is stated, and no source confirms the civil-process implementation began

subject: dpi.mis
name: Sistema Integrado de Gestao Escolar (SIGE)
milestone: US$1m GPE grant approved 2026-04-08 to expand and modernise it
position_start: No school or student information system named in the repository
position_end: Piloted in two secondary schools in 2009 and completed across every secondary school in the country by July 2018, made compulsory for the 2025/26 school year, and funded for expansion and modernisation by a US$1m Global Partnership for Education grant approved 2026-04-08

subject: dpi.mis
name: Social security institute's benefit and self-service systems
milestone: Mobile application presented at the internet governance forum
position_end: There is no single integrated social protection platform; delivery runs on institutional systems. The social security institute and the employment institute publicly presented the unemployment benefit award system in July 2020, supporting management of the benefit from application through to award and joining the two institutions' processes; the same institute presented its mobile application in April 2026 after it took the public innovation and best mobile application prizes at the national digital awards. Coverage is the contributory regime only, and the beneficiary system for the social inclusion income was still described as forthcoming in November 2025

subject: dpi.mis
name: SYDONIA World customs management system
milestone: Migration to version 4.4.0 reviewed 9 July 2026
position_end: The customs system entered operation across the whole national territory on 14 September 2015, removing paper from the detailed declaration, national transit and collection guides, with documents scanned and attached to the file and online tracking of dossiers by operators. A technical review on 9 July 2026 recorded migration to version 4.4.0, modernisation of the technological infrastructure, strengthened customs value controls, new customs modules and integration services, funded by the Digital Cabo Verde project and running November 2023 to July 2026; named next-phase priorities are the single window for foreign trade, institutional interoperability and risk management. A consultancy to revise the customs code and its implementing regulation went to expressions of interest on 3 February 2026

milestone: NOSi preliminary report attributes the 2026-05-17 failure to technical causes
position_start: NOSi's stated performance was publication of election results within two hours
position_end: The results portal became unreachable from about 19:00 on 2026-05-17 during legislative-election results publication and was restored by about 21:00; an external independent technical and forensic audit is under way, its preliminary indications pointing to technical causes and finding no evidence of external malicious action, with internal conduct still being examined
note: NOSi's president initially said a cyber-attack was more likely than a technical fault; the board's preliminary report nine days later said the opposite

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Gov.cv unified services portal
milestone: Decreto-Lei 36/2026 gazetted 2026-05-21
position_start: Named as the integrated public-services portal and stated by government as in advanced development (2024-12-18), a named deliverable since 2023; no single portal live
position_end: Decreto-Lei 36/2026 sets the rules and principles for delivering public services through the Portal Unico, its fees regime and the rules for electronic consultation of State-held data, making it the transactional channel for electronic registry and notarial acts, with a 10% reduction on services completed through it
note: The Prime Minister's own account is that departmental platforms did not communicate with each other before this date

subject: dpi.govtech
name: IGRP platform
milestone: Named by the responsible minister at the CPLP e-governance meeting
position_start: The open-source microservices framework on which the state's e-government applications are built and managed across their lifecycle, on the government's own characterisation
position_end: Same; no later source revises it
sources: 2025-03-26-cpv-eurico-monteiro-governacao-electronica-cplp|2024-01-01 Cabo Verde targets 60pct of vital public services online by 2026 (NOSi)

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Municipal services platform
milestone: Public presentation set for October 2026, operation by end-2026
position_start: Did not exist
position_end: A municipal council presented a services platform it plans to put into public presentation in October 2026 and into operation by the end of that year, opening with 17 services: residents will be able to submit applications, track their cases in real time, make payments and receive official documents in digital form with legal validity. It is funded by the UN joint office, whose resident coordinator called 17 services a good starting point and asked the council to consider integrating further procedures in a second phase, while the minister for family, inclusion, social development and labour argued for keeping and improving traditional counter services for those still facing difficulties with digital access, and for replicating the model in the other municipalities if it succeeds

subject: dpi.govtech
name: Portal de Justica (justica.gov.cv)
milestone: Launched in Praia under Decreto-Lei 53/2024 of 4 November
position_start: Live behind the Autentika single sign-on, serving land, commercial, vehicle and criminal-record certificates, civil-status certificates, identity-card renewal and appointment booking
position_end: Same; no later source revises its scope, and its relationship to Gov.cv after 2026-02-24 is not stated
note: Government framed it at launch as one component of the integrated portal Gov.cv later delivered

subject: digital.localgov
name: Municipal information system
milestone: Successor platform presented to municipalities
position_end: The state technology operator's own strategic plan records that the municipal information system was deployed in three municipalities in 2001-2003, extended to a fourth in 2007, and that its second version was implemented nationally between 2008 and 2012 and functions in all municipalities with uneven functionality. Its integrated paperless successor was presented to municipal supervisors and directors at a workshop on 11 November 2025, the responsible minister describing it as an update of the existing system with municipal staff training programmed alongside it and accountability, transparency and citizen participation as its stated purposes. No deployment date, municipality list or budget for the successor is published

subject: digital.rural
name: Akelius digital learning project in basic education
milestone: Fourteen schools reached at the close of 2025/26
position_end: A partnership of the education ministry with a United Nations agency and a foundation, running since 2022 and reaching five islands and fourteen schools by the end of the 2025/26 school year. The agency's education lead states the schools met their targets for children reached, that the gains are pedagogical differentiation tools and greater stimulus in learning, and that digital resources strengthened inclusion of children with special educational needs. Priorities set for 2026/27 are resource management and a stronger supervisory role in the practical organisation of lessons. No enrolment figure, school list or per-island split is published

subject: digital.rural
name: Digital coverage of the health service network
milestone: Health charter adopted as a binding planning instrument
position_end: The health ministry's own terms of reference state the standing position: the financial component of the health information system is used in all service structures, the registration module on Santiago island only, DHIS2 in production across all structures for aggregated data, and the single patient medical record application only in the health structures of the capital, because of licence cost and network limitations. The network is three regional hospitals, thirty-two health centres across ten islands and 22 municipalities, and two health stations. The health charter adopted on 30 December 2025 integrates digital transformation of the service in structured form, naming interoperable information systems, telemedicine, diagnostic innovation and artificial intelligence applied to imaging and clinical decision support, and provides for raising base health units to health posts and those to health centres

subject: digital.rural
name: Electronic criminal process in the National Police
milestone: Installation completed on the last island 28 November 2025
position_end: Portaria Conjunta 50/2024 declares the phased entry into operation of the justice information system and its criminal process subsystem and makes use of the electronic criminal process obligatory in the National Police; the gazette record carries the publication reference and sumario, and the operative text is served only to an authenticated account and is not held. Installation was completed on Brava, the smallest and most remote inhabited island, on 28 November 2025, integrating all 17 comarcas of the country

subject: digital.rural
name: Electronic registration acts and remote access to registry services
milestone: First usage figures published for the justice portal
position_end: Decreto-Lei 43/2007 regulates the practice of registration acts, their archiving and the issue of the corresponding means of proof in electronic form, and allows a certidao to be requested at any conservatoria or through the one-stop shop rather than only where the entry is held; the same supplement carries the decree on electronic certidoes and access to public administration databases. The justice ministry published the first usage figures on 16 December 2025: 905 acts performed without any physical attendance at a conservatoria, of which 290 birth certificates, 150 identity card renewals, 148 property certificates, 95 commercial certificates, 71 marriage, 59 vehicle registrations, 58 criminal record certificates, 22 death and 12 acknowledgements of paternity

subject: digital.rural
name: National telemedicine service equipment programme
milestone: Equipment handed over 18 December 2025
position_end: Twenty-four telemedicine units, twenty-four videoconference systems and two digital microscopes worth CVE 240,000,000, funded by Japan, were formally handed to the health ministry on 18 December 2025. The ministry states that installation is under way, that all 22 municipalities will have at least one health facility fully equipped with telemedicine, and that the programme is to be integrated into the health information system. No installation completion, consultation volume or facility list is published

subject: tech.ai

milestone: Stated to be under way by the Finance Minister at the Praia customs house
position_start: The repository carries no statement of this contract at the start of the window
position_end: A US$9m contract for AI-assisted scanning equipment at the national ports is stated to be under way, inside a stated programme for a fully digitised national revenue directorate built on artificial intelligence and data management; its signature date and counterparty are not established
note: The figure is stated in US dollars by the announcing minister; no escudo equivalent and no conversion date is given

subject: tech.ai
name: Artificial intelligence in the justice sector
milestone: Integrated artificial intelligence demonstrated 23 October 2025
position_end: The justice modernisation institute ran the country's first national training on artificial intelligence for justice professionals from 22 September 2025, 226 enrolled over thirty hours covering fundamentals, intelligent management of judicial proceedings, ethics and data protection, and practical applications in law. On 23 October 2025 the institute's president presented the justice portal and demonstrated an Inteligencia Artificial Integrada initiative, a chat built to help citizens reach information and digital services. The ministry describes a demonstration rather than a confirmed production deployment, and the digital economy strategy still carries implementation of an artificial intelligence strategy as a measure yet to be taken

subject: tech.ai
name: Data-protection commission guidance on artificial intelligence
milestone: Joint declaration on AI-generated images subscribed
position_end: The commission subscribed on 27 February 2026 to the joint declaration on artificial-intelligence-generated images issued four days earlier by 61 data protection authorities, which sets requirements on developers and users of generative systems covering security measures against non-consensual intimate imagery, transparency about system capabilities and permitted uses, accessible takedown mechanisms for harmful content involving personal data, and reinforced safeguards where children are depicted. It is regulator guidance and not binding national legislation; at an African governance workshop in October 2025 the commission stated the country's own position, that it needs legislation to regulate artificial intelligence

subject: tech.ai
name: Limits on solely automated decisions and profiling
milestone: Lei 121/IX/2021 amends the general data-protection regime
position_end: No standalone artificial-intelligence statute. The binding rule that reaches algorithmic use is the 2021 second amendment of the general personal data protection regime: it defines profiling, prohibits discriminatory profiles, limits decisions taken solely by automated processing where they produce legal effects or significantly affect the data subject, requires transparency about the decision logic, and requires impact assessments for high-risk technologies. The data-protection commission's own stated position is that the country needs legislation to regulate artificial intelligence

subject: tech.ai
name: National Artificial Intelligence Strategy
milestone: Development process kicked off at an EU-supported meeting
position_start: None published; a named analyst noted on 2025-04-07 that more than 60 countries had national AI strategies and argued Cabo Verde should adopt one
position_end: Drafting under way, kicked off with senior officials, the Secretary of State for the Digital Economy, external consultants and European Union representatives; the government states the framework will be designed for responsible and ethical use of AI in the public interest. No draft text, timetable or budget is held
note: Paired with the data strategy in one kick-off; the two are separate instruments

subject: tech.ai
name: Proposal for a CPLP laboratory for artificial intelligence in health
milestone: Proposed by the Health Minister at the WHO global conference on AI in health, Lisbon
position_start: Did not exist as a stated national position
position_end: The Health Minister proposes Cabo Verde as a lusophone laboratory for AI in health, hosting pilot projects integrating AI with telemedicine, and calls for cooperation on skills, digital infrastructure, interoperability and an ethical and regulatory framework. No pilot, partner, budget or instrument is held
note: A ministerial proposal at an international conference, not a domestic programme

No budget, legal basis, target or timetable is held

note: The exact dates of the 2026 edition are not published in the source

position_start: A dedicated startup law carrying tax benefits, a special technology economic zone, modern data-protection and digital-transactions laws, simplified business registration and a digital-nomad visa are all stated to be in place
position_end: Unchanged; no instrument number, adoption date, text or take-up figure for either the startup law or the visa is held

subject: capacity.literacy
name: Digital and data training for public servants
milestone: 126 revenue staff trained on data protection
position_end: The digital governance strategy's annex carries the standing national policy in its intervention area for digital literacy of human resources, with a capacity-building programme in digital technologies for the public administration and an e-learning content team. Two dated sessions sit under it: the first national training on artificial intelligence for justice professionals from 22 September 2025 with 226 enrolled, and a session on personal data processing for 126 staff of the national revenue directorate on 12 February 2026, delivered by the data-protection commission's president and part of a February and March cycle also covering biometrics and use of electronic means in the workplace. No national figure for civil servants trained in digital skills is published

name: Accredited computing qualifications
milestone: A further computing degree accredited 17 April 2026
position_end: The higher education regulator's consolidated register of accredited and registered study cycles, last updated 24 February 2026, is the authoritative statement of which computing qualifications exist and are currently accredited across the country's eleven higher education institutions, and marks discontinued provision separately. Two dated additions sit on it: the second edition of the university's master's in computing engineering opened on 24 March 2026 with eighteen students, most modules now taught by Cabo Verdean staff rather than the Portuguese partner university, and the gazette of 17 April 2026 carries the regulator's accreditation and registration of a bachelor's in computing engineering at a second university's capital campus

subject: capacity.training
name: BOOST.CV
milestone: Launched 2025-07-28
position_start: Launched on 2025-07-28 to back 150 young digital entrepreneurs with training, mentoring and project incubation, three days before the window opened
position_end: Unchanged; the repository carries no participant, completion, funding or outcome figure after launch

subject: capacity.training
name: Digital subjects in the secondary curriculum
milestone: Teacher guide published for the compulsory ninth-year subject
position_end: Information and communication technologies is a compulsory ninth-year subject of 70 hours a year covering digital literacy, security and digital citizenship, internet research, communication and collaboration and multimedia production, and the education ministry published its official teacher guide on 30 April 2026. Introduction to programming exists as a tenth and eleventh-year subject in the science and technology option, three hours a week across 38 weeks, written by the national education directorate with the university; the copy served is marked experimental, so it establishes the subject's formal existence and not universal delivery. Outreach sits alongside the curriculum: the state technology operator ran a girls in ICT day for 14 girls aged 14 to 18 on 23 April 2026

subject: capacity.training
name: National strategy of skills and digital readiness
milestone: Workshop on the draft strategy held in Praia
position_start: Under preparation inside the World Bank-financed Digital Cabo Verde project, informed by a digital-readiness study covering more than a thousand people across several islands; not adopted
position_end: Still not adopted. The repository holds no adoption instrument, no publication and no target date a year after the workshop
note: The Secretary of State's claim that stronger digital skills could double GDP is an official statement, not a modelled estimate the wiki holds

subject: capacity.training
name: NOSi Akademia
milestone: First Alumni Talk 2026 held 2026-03-10
position_start: The repository carries no position on NOSi Akademia at 2025-08-01
position_end: Reported by the government at about 3,000 applications and more than 600 internships since 2016; the first Alumni Talk was held inside Semana do Digital, opened by the Finance and Digital Economy Minister
note: Both figures are cumulative since 2016 and carry no annual breakdown

subject: capacity.training
name: Skodji Digital
milestone: First cohort sessions held at Praia and Mindelo
position_start: Did not exist; the repository carries no programme of this kind before January 2026
position_end: Formally launched in late January 2026 with 1,050 places in a first phase against a stated 3,000-opportunity target, applications closing 2026-02-25 and training running two to six months; funded by the World Bank through the Digital Cabo Verde Project at a reported EUR 400,000. No enrolment, completion or placement figure is held
note: Open to residents and the diaspora; against youth unemployment reported at 27.8% in February 2026

subject: capacity.research

subject: capacity.research
name: University research centres bearing on digital policy
milestone: Fact-checking centre constituted 10 December 2025
position_end: Two centres were constituted inside six weeks. The university's business and governance school launched a research centre in business and governance on 31 October 2025, its tenth active centre, with 25 members and 81 publications and research lines including governance, public policy and development, and a named project for an observatory turning official statistics and central bank data into cost-of-living and municipal development indices as input to public policy. On 10 December 2025 the university, the media regulator and the journalists' union signed the protocol creating an independent non-profit fact-checking centre on a hybrid model of regulation, academic research and journalistic practice, the university holding the scientific nucleus and a United Nations joint office supporting a monitoring platform

subject: include.access

position_end: CVE 74,050,000 for FY2026 across two sub-lines only, service quality and new technological infrastructure; the total rose while the two lines naming physical and one-stop-shop access disappeared

subject: include.access
name: Estrategia para a Inclusao da Pessoa com Deficiencia 2024-2030
milestone: Approved by Resolucao 98/2024
position_end: The operative national instrument, approved on 11 November 2024, over a population the 2021 census records as 47,021 people with a disability, 10.9 per cent of the total. Its fifth axis covers physical, communication and technological accessibility and sets out digital public-service accessibility, auditing of websites and applications and assistive-technology measures, costed at 206,500 thousand escudos, 6 per cent of the plan's budget. No audit, compliance figure or implementation report is held

subject: include.access
name: Fee regime for residence and travel documents for foreign nationals
milestone: Portaria 40/2025 in force from 1 February 2026
position_end: Portaria 40/2025 replaces the 1999 and 2012 fee schedules and sets the whole regime of fees and surcharges charged by the foreigners and borders directorate for visas, residence authorisations and the residence title for foreign nationals. Three provisions bear on digital access: where the act or service is requested electronically the proof of payment is to be furnished by the same channel; the individual tourism visa requested on the online traveller pre-registration platform is priced at CVE 2,500; and refugees and stateless persons and their families, victims of human trafficking and of gender-based violence are exempt from fees, with travel documents for refugees and stateless persons issued free. No count of refugees or stateless persons documented is published

subject: include.access
name: Gender gap in the digital economy
milestone: Training container installed on Brava
position_end: The country's own figures, published in a financier's appraisal document, are that women are 37 per cent of information and communications technology workers, 20 per cent of engineering and technology researchers and 8 per cent of tertiary science and technology graduates, with 36 per cent female completion of the state operator's web labs in 2019 against a target of at least 50 per cent. No later measurement is held. Two 2026 measures sit against it: memoranda signed on 15 January bringing a bank for young people and women into operation, and a digital week training container installed at a secondary school on Brava with about fifteen high-performance computers, aimed by the minister's own statement at the island's young people and women

subject: data.statistics
name: Estrategia Nacional de Desenvolvimento da Estatistica 2022-2026
milestone: Fisheries statistical system put to expressions of interest
position_end: The fourth national statistics strategy, authored by the statistics institute, on four strategic objectives: widening and coordinating the national statistical system, strengthening human, material, technological and financial capacity, improving coverage and quality of statistical production, and strengthening communication, dissemination and use of official statistics. The budget support group's mission communique of November 2025 records progress on implementation, calls for a dedicated fund for statistical production to give the strategy predictable financing, and asks that gender indicators be consolidated in the system. A consultancy to evaluate and modernise the fisheries statistical system went to expressions of interest on 7 July 2026 under a World Bank credit. The strategy's own term ends in 2026 and no successor is held

position_start: Fieldwork begun December 2022, definitive results unpublished
position_end: Still unpublished at 2026-07-25, so the World Bank microsimulated its July 2026 poverty estimate from the III IDRF of 2015; the statistics institute states an under-reporting of food expenditure was identified and corrected, and that a new fully digital survey was planned for July 2026

position_end: World Bank estimates of 53.8% (2024), 51.2% (2025) and a projected 49.2% (2026) on the US$8.30/day PPP-2021 upper-middle-income line, microsimulated from the 2015 survey rather than measured

subject: data.satellite
name: Geospatial laboratory at the agrarian research institute
milestone: Laboratory inaugurated 15 March 2022
position_end: A geospatial laboratory opened with the national agrarian research and development institute on Santiago and inaugurated on 15 March 2022 by the head of government and the agriculture minister, under a cooperation with a Dutch earth observation faculty that builds national capacity to map the rural space from medium to high-resolution satellite data and is building the institute a water and food security monitoring system on near-real-time satellite observations. No national record of the facility was located: the source is the partner institution that runs the cooperation

subject: data.satellite
name: Meteorological watch and early warning
milestone: Early warnings for all launched nationally
position_end: Portaria 3/2021 approves the organic structure of the meteorology and geophysics institute and vests in it the national meteorological and climate watch, forecasting and the issue of warnings and alerts, aeronautical meteorology for the oceanic flight information region, marine and agrometeorological information, and coordination of the national observation networks and of data collection, processing and meteorological models. On 16 December 2025 the country launched the national roll-out of the United Nations early warnings for all initiative, whose detection and forecasting pillar the institute carries, setting a coordination framework and unified roadmap over an observations financing facility already being implemented and a climate fund proposal in preparation for a multi-hazard system. It is an institutional and financing step around the observation capability rather than a new receiving station or satellite product

subject: geopol.gulf
name: Gulf digital engagement
milestone: Cooperation stated at Web Summit Qatar
position_end: A declared wish and no instrument. At a press conference on 3 February 2026 during Web Summit Qatar the Secretary of State for the Digital Economy stated the country's wish to strengthen cooperation with Qatar at both governmental and private-sector level, describing the summit as a bridge for Doha to reach Africa, and set out the national digital ecosystem, internet penetration of about 98 subscriptions per 100 people and a technology park with investment above US$70 million. No memorandum, financing commitment or implementation step with any Gulf state is held
